title: Sr Multicolour Coleus - 1x Mini Plug Plant - Rare Coleus Variety
description:
Bring a burst of vibrant colour to your garden or home with these stunning Coleus plug plants!


KEY FEATURES
• Stunning multicoloured foliage for continuous visual interest
• Versatile for garden beds, containers, hanging baskets, and houseplants
• Easy to grow and maintain, suitable for all gardening levels
• Rapid growth provides quick impact in your displays
• Tolerant of various light conditions, including newer sun-tolerant varieties


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Houseplants — Coleus scutellarioides
Colour: Green, yellow, pink, red, rust, maroon (foliage); blue (flowers)
Season: Summer (foliage); late summer (flowers)
Growth Habit: Bushy, mounding, trailing (variety dependent)


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Partial shade to full sun (variety dependent)
Soil: Well-drained, rich, organic soil
Watering: Keep soil evenly moist; water when top 1-2 inches of soil are dry. Container plants require more frequent watering.
Spacing: 30-45 cm (12-18 inches)
Height: 30-90 cm (1-3 feet)
Spread: 30-90 cm (1-3 feet)
Hardiness: H1B (UK), USDA 10-11 (grown as annuals in cooler zones)


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant outdoors after all danger of frost has passed and soil temperatures are above 15°C (60°F).
• Pinch back growing shoots frequently to encourage branching and a denser plant.
• Remove flower spikes as they appear to direct energy into foliage growth.
• Fertilise monthly during the growing season with a balanced all-purpose fertiliser to promote lush foliage.
• Ensure good drainage; avoid overwatering to prevent root rot.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
